references.text: The original instruction to make braided chains of pure gold for the breastpiece.
The original instructions to make two gold rings and attach them to the two ends of the breastpiece.
Describes the onyx stones that were set in gold settings (mishbetsot), using the same craftsmanship technique employed here.
Earlier in the chapter concerning the completion of the breastpiece (hoshen) to which the rings are now attached.
The instruction regarding gold settings (mishbetsot zahav) as engraved work, using the same technique applied here.
The original instruction for placing the rings (28:23) is compared with the actual execution in 39:16.
The instruction for the lower rings (28:26) represents the missing half of the construction process completed in 39:16.
Attaching the cords to the rings (28:24) is the next logical step after the rings have been attached to the corners (39:16).
